content: प्रवेशः .²1 Entrance, penetration; पुरप्रवेशाभिमुखो बभूव <ls>R. 7. 1</ls>; <ls>Ku. 3. 60</ls>. .²2 Ingress, access, approach. .²3 Entrance on the stage; तेन पात्रप्रवेशश्चेत् <ls>S. D. 6</ls>. .²4 The entrance or door (of a house <ab>&c.</ab>). .²5 Income, revenue. .²6 Close application (to a pursuit), intentness of purpose. .²7 The entrance of the sun into a sign of the zodiac. .²8 Coming on, setting in (of night). .²9 The syringe of a clyster-pipe. .²10 Employment, use. (Proverb-- चञ्चुप्रवेशो मुसलप्रवेशः; <ab>cf.</ab> ‘the thin end of the wedge’). .²11 Manner, method.
